title: Growth Product Manager Learning Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to build the fundamentals, core product growth skills, a showcase portfolio, and job‑ready expertise. Follow each phase to move from zero experience to a confident growth PM.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Learn the basics of product growth, data, and communication.

milestones.title: Growth Mindset & Basics
milestones.outcome: Can explain the growth loop and key metrics for SaaS products.

tasks.title: Read growth loop overview
tasks.description: Study the growth loop article on the GrowthHackers blog and note each stage.

tasks.title: Watch funnel basics video
tasks.description: View the freeCodeCamp YouTube video on conversion funnels and write a one‑page summary.

tasks.title: Sketch a product funnel
tasks.description: Create a simple funnel diagram for a familiar app on paper or a digital tool.

tasks.title: Reflect on funnel gaps
tasks.description: Identify two points in your sketch where users might drop off and suggest a hypothesis.

milestones.title: Data Literacy & SQL Intro
milestones.outcome: Can write basic SELECT queries to retrieve user data.

tasks.title: Complete SQL basics module
tasks.description: Finish the introductory SQL lessons on Khan Academy, focusing on SELECT, FROM, WHERE.

tasks.title: Set up a free DB sandbox
tasks.description: Create a free PostgreSQL instance on ElephantSQL and connect with a client tool.

tasks.title: Query sample user table
tasks.description: Write three queries: list users, filter active users, count sign‑ups per day.

tasks.title: Explain query results
tasks.description: Summarize what each query tells you about user behavior in a short paragraph.

milestones.title: Analytics Tools Overview
milestones.outcome: Can navigate a free analytics dashboard and locate key reports.

tasks.title: Explore Google Analytics demo
tasks.description: Use the Google Analytics Demo Account to locate audience, acquisition, and behavior reports.

tasks.title: Create a custom segment
tasks.description: Define a segment for new users in the demo and view its funnel conversion.

tasks.title: Read Mixpanel basics guide
tasks.description: Read Mixpanel’s free getting‑started guide and note differences from GA.

tasks.title: Connect with a community
tasks.description: Join the Product Growth Slack channel and introduce yourself, asking a question about metrics.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop experiment design, copy, onboarding, and prioritisation abilities.

milestones.title: Experiment Design Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can craft a hypothesis, define metrics, and outline an A/B test plan.

tasks.title: Read experiment design article
tasks.description: Study the Optimizely guide on hypothesis formation and success metrics.

tasks.title: Write three hypotheses
tasks.description: Generate three growth hypotheses for a hypothetical app, each with a clear metric.

tasks.title: Draft an A/B test plan
tasks.description: Outline sample size, duration, and variant details for one hypothesis.

tasks.title: Get feedback from peers
tasks.description: Post your test plan in the Growth Slack channel and incorporate one suggestion.

tasks.title: Reflect on learnings
tasks.description: Write a brief note on what makes a good experiment versus a vanity metric.

milestones.title: Copy & Onboarding Tactics
milestones.outcome: Can audit onboarding flow and write persuasive copy for a signup page.

tasks.title: Watch onboarding teardown video
tasks.description: View the Product School video on onboarding audits and list key checkpoints.

tasks.title: Audit a public signup page
tasks.description: Choose a free SaaS product, record each step, and note friction points.

tasks.title: Rewrite headline copy
tasks.description: Create three alternative headlines for the signup page focusing on benefit language.

tasks.title: Test copy with a friend
tasks.description: Show the three headlines to a peer and record which is most compelling.

tasks.title: Summarize onboarding insights
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary of the audit and copy improvements.

milestones.title: Prioritisation Frameworks
milestones.outcome: Can apply RICE or ICE to rank growth ideas objectively.

tasks.title: Read RICE framework article
tasks.description: Study the Intercom article on RICE scoring and note each component.

tasks.title: Score five growth ideas
tasks.description: Take five sample ideas and calculate RICE scores in a spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Create a prioritisation board
tasks.description: Set up a Trello board with columns for scores and move ideas accordingly.

tasks.title: Discuss scores with a mentor
tasks.description: Share your board in a mentorship chat and ask for critique.

tasks.title: Reflect on trade‑offs
tasks.description: Write a short note on how reach vs. effort influenced your rankings.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Build portfolio projects that demonstrate your growth expertise.

milestones.title: Funnel Analysis Project
milestones.outcome: Can present a data‑driven funnel report with actionable insights.

tasks.title: Select a public product
tasks.description: Choose a well‑known SaaS (e.g., Notion) and locate its public usage data or case study.

tasks.title: Gather funnel data
tasks.description: Use Google Analytics Demo or SimilarWeb to extract sign‑up, activation, and retention numbers.

tasks.title: Create analysis deck
tasks.description: Build a 5‑slide PowerPoint deck showing the funnel, drop‑off points, and recommendations.

tasks.title: Record a walkthrough video
tasks.description: Film a 3‑minute video narrating the deck and upload to YouTube as unlisted.

tasks.title: Share for feedback
tasks.description: Post the deck link in the Product Growth community and incorporate one suggestion.

milestones.title: Experiment Backlog Project
milestones.outcome: Can showcase a prioritized backlog with sizing and test plans.

tasks.title: List 10 growth ideas
tasks.description: Brainstorm ten ideas for improving sign‑ups for a chosen app and write one‑sentence descriptions.

tasks.title: Apply RICE scoring
tasks.description: Score each idea using the RICE framework in a Google Sheet.

tasks.title: Write test outlines
tasks.description: For the top three ideas, draft brief A/B test outlines with hypothesis and metric.

tasks.title: Design a backlog board
tasks.description: Create a Notion page displaying the ranked ideas, scores, and test outlines.

tasks.title: Publish and solicit input
tasks.description: Share the Notion link on LinkedIn with a short post asking for feedback.

milestones.title: Onboarding Teardown Project
milestones.outcome: Can deliver a detailed critique of an onboarding flow with copy suggestions.

tasks.title: Choose an onboarding flow
tasks.description: Select a free app’s first‑time user experience and document each screen.

tasks.title: Map user steps
tasks.description: Create a flowchart in Lucidchart showing the onboarding sequence.

tasks.title: Identify friction points
tasks.description: Mark at least three steps where users may drop off and note why.

tasks.title: Propose copy revisions
tasks.description: Write revised copy for each friction point focusing on clarity and value.

tasks.title: Compile a case study
tasks.description: Assemble screenshots, findings, and revised copy into a PDF case study.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance your toolkit and prepare for interviews or client pitches.

milestones.title: Advanced Analytics & Cohort Analysis
milestones.outcome: Can run cohort queries and interpret retention curves.

tasks.title: Read cohort analysis guide
tasks.description: Study the Mixpanel free guide on cohort analysis and retention metrics.

tasks.title: Write a cohort SQL query
tasks.description: Using your sandbox DB, query user cohorts by signup week and calculate 30‑day retention.

tasks.title: Visualize retention chart
tasks.description: Plot the results in Google Sheets and add trend lines.

tasks.title: Explain insights to a peer
tasks.description: Present the chart in a 5‑minute call and discuss key takeaways.

tasks.title: Reflect on analysis limits
tasks.description: Write a short note on what data is missing for deeper insights.

milestones.title: Interview Prep & Storytelling
milestones.outcome: Can answer growth PM interview questions with concrete examples.

tasks.title: Study common growth PM questions
tasks.description: Read the Product Management interview guide on Glassdoor focusing on growth scenarios.

tasks.title: Craft STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) stories using your portfolio projects.

tasks.title: Mock interview with a friend
tasks.description: Run a 30‑minute mock interview covering metrics, experiments, and prioritisation.

tasks.title: Record answers on video
tasks.description: Film yourself answering two questions and review for clarity and impact.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn profile
tasks.description: Add the three portfolio projects and a headline highlighting growth expertise.

milestones.title: Negotiation & Client Pitching
milestones.outcome: Can pitch growth initiatives and negotiate scope with stakeholders.

tasks.title: Read pitch deck basics
tasks.description: Study the free Pitch Deck template from Slidebean and note structure tips.

tasks.title: Create a growth pitch deck
tasks.description: Build a 7‑slide deck proposing an experiment backlog for a target company.

tasks.title: Practice pitch delivery
tasks.description: Rehearse the deck aloud for 10 minutes, focusing on concise copy and value proposition.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a mentor
tasks.description: Share the deck with a senior PM via email and incorporate one improvement.

tasks.title: Reflect on negotiation points
tasks.description: Write a brief list of possible objections and prepared responses.
